source.dataset: Melbourne Pedestrian Counting System (per-minute), live collection 2026-10 (ped_poll)
source.selection_rule: spec §4.139 / §4.132 item 4, general band (§4.53 thresholds), seed 20261011, pool rank 7
source.pipeline: per-minute counts -> 1min resample+interp -> 5min centered rolling mean -> 4:1 compression (mean of 4) -> UE=clip(round(40*C/Cmax),1,40) -> 2-UE deadband quantization
